title: Figure and explanation
description: The title across the top, a figure column (figure, legend, short text) and an explanation column side by side. Stacks on narrow screens, figure first.

balance.description: figure: a wider figure column; activity: a wider explanation column, for an activity next to the figure.

figure.description: column: the figure's blocks one under the other; stack: drawn over each other in one square frame, for a figure built in steps (an image with its caption first, then orbit flights and hotspots).
